purpose: T95 BTC->alt hourly lead-lag measurement on the expanded hourly PIT cohort: does the BTC 1h mark return predict each alt's NEXT-hour return and next-4h return beyond contemporaneous correlation (shared market beta). Measurement only - no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

cohort.grid: all 5 assets share the identical 3592-bar hourly decision_ns grid (one 53h gap); mark_price present on every record
cohort.label: label.forward_return_bps (perp_forward_mark_return_up_25bps_4h_gross; numeric bps present on all 17960 records)
cohort.returns: 1h mark returns recomputed per asset as mark[t]/mark[t-1h]-1 from features.mark_price (PIT-stamped at decision bar)

arms.L1_next_hour: per alt in {ETH,BNB,SOL,XRP}: Spearman(btc_ret_1h[t], alt_ret_1h[t+1h]) on aligned timestamps; baseline Spearman(btc_ret_1h[t], alt_ret_1h[t]) contemporaneous; sanity Spearman(alt_ret_1h[t], btc_ret_1h[t+1h]) reverse direction
arms.L2_next_4h: per alt: Spearman(btc_ret_1h[t], alt label.forward_return_bps[t]) — last completed BTC hour vs alt's next-4h label; baseline Spearman(btc label[t], alt label[t]) contemporaneous 4h co-movement
arms.C_conditioned: BTC bars split by trailing-90-record mid-rank pct of |btc_ret_1h|: big (pct>=0.9) up/down by sign vs small; per-cell alt next-1h and next-4h mean/median bps (pooled across alts + per-alt table); does follow-through require big BTC moves
arms.D_beta_decay: per alt: rho_contemporaneous - rho_lagged_1h drop and rho_lag/rho_contemp ratio (beta decay), plus BTC own lag-1 autocorrelation as context; honest verdict on tradability vs ~10bps round-trip taker cost

statistics.test: Spearman rank correlation (mid-rank ties), t-approx normal two-sided p (same convention as financial_signal_crossvenue_v1); Welch two-sample t for conditioned cells, normal-approx two-sided p; min n=10 per side
statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR alpha=0.05 over the evaluated family (<=12: 8 predictive Spearman cells + 4 conditioned Welch contrasts); contemporaneous/reverse baselines are reported outside the family
caveats: cross-asset bars sharing a timestamp are correlated through the common market factor; pooled conditioned cells overstate effective sample size
4h forward labels on 1h bars overlap ~4x -> positive autocorrelation; Spearman/Welch p-values nominal/optimistic
1h returns are non-overlapping but serially/cross-sectionally dependent; treat p<0.01 as suggestive, not decisive
first 90 bars of the BTC series lack a trailing pct and drop out of the conditioned arm only
